2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch replaces the 'nosteal_pipe_buf_ops' with 'default_pipe_buf_ops' in various parts of the Linux kernel, including fuse and splice code. The change is made because both operations are identical, and using a single set of default operations simplifies the code and reduces the risk of bugs. The patch also exports the 'default_pipe_buf_ops' symbol to make it available for use by other modules, such as fuse, which can be built as a module.
